headline: Approved site control of 142 South Bend Street for a new unified high school; referred teacher contract and pay items to Finance Committee.
summary: Site control of 142 South Bend Street was given to the School Committee for a new unified high school, by an 8-1 roll call vote. The teacher contract, Teamsters pay plan, and parking enforcement officer items were referred to the Finance Committee. Several claims for damages against the city were approved, denied, or referred.
decisions: Approved the records of the August 19, 2026 meeting as prepared by the Clerk.
Approved the consent agenda on a unanimous voice vote.
Referred the Teamsters Local 251 new contract and pay plan to the Finance Committee.
Laid on the table the ordinance repealing and replacing pay rates for Local 251, and referred it to the Finance Committee.
Referred the request to establish a parking enforcement officer position to the Finance Committee.
Laid on the table the ordinance adding a parking enforcement officer to Local 3960 pay rates, and referred it to the Finance Committee.
Referred eight damage claims against the city to the Committee on Claims and Pending Suits.
Referred the $54,100.00 property damage claim by Oluwatoyin Wilcox to the Law Department and RI Interlocal Trust.
Passed a motion asking the Clerk to request a Stop Ahead sign on Rice Street, 9-0 by voice vote.
Referred the Pawtucket School Committee and Teachers’ Alliance contract for 2026 through 2029 to the Finance Committee.
Approved site control of 142 South Bend Street for a new unified high school, 8-1 on a roll call vote.
Approved Lisa Jones’s $300.00 pothole damage claim, 9-0 on a roll call vote.
Denied the claims by Juan Hernandez ($680.96) and Bernard Donald Grossi, Jr. ($140.00), 9-0 on a roll call vote.
Denied Norka Quezada’s $1,350.00 claim and referred it to the City of Central Falls, 9-0 on a roll call vote.
Denied Megan Loiselle’s $375.00 claim and referred it to JR Vinagro Construction Corp., 9-0 on a roll call vote.
Denied Irma Velez-Parent’s $94.00 claim and referred it to Geneva Apartments LLC, 9-0 on a roll call vote.
